tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: dpal rdo rje gzhon nu thugs kyi thig le las: lha dbang bzhugs so:

thugs dam gsang ba'i lha mchog dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo: rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i lte ba nas: mi gnas mi 'gyur dpal chen ku mā ra: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs shes rab yum dang sbyor: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba big nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: steng gi phyogs nas thog chen 'beb mdzad pa: hūm̐ kār sgra 'byin phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐: gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas dgra bgegs gzir mdzad pa: rnam rgyal snyems ma stag dang bya rgod mgo: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐: ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: shar lho mtshams nas dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad pa: dbyug sngon sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo: skal ldan= oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐: da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya= hūm̐ḥ lho yi phyogs nas dgra bgegs gsod mdzad pa: gshin rje dur khrod sha wa 'ug pa'i mgo: skal ldan= oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐: pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya= hūm̐: lho nub mtshams nas dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad pa: mi g.yo gtun khung gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo: skal ldan= oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐: bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya= hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas dgra bgegs 'ching mdzad pa: rta mgrin gtum mo byi la pu shud mgo: skal ldan= oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṝ wa hūm̐: hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya= hūm̐: nub byang mtshams nas dgra bgegs 'gugs mdzad pa: 'dod rgyal mda' snyems ce spyang khra yi mgo: skal ldan= oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa:

kā ya= hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas dgra bgegs gnon mdzad pa: bdud rtsi rlung 'byin seng ge pha waṃ mgo: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐: tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: byang shar mtshams nas dgra bgegs stob mdzad pa: khams gsum gsod ma dom dang sre mong mgo: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐: bhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: 'og gi phyogs nas dgra bgegs spor mdzad pa: stobs chen skyod ma dred dang byi ba'i mgo: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā bā la hūm̐: s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: spyi bo'i gtsug tu dbang bskur ro: dam can rnams kyi sbams phur gyis dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs: sngon chad ji ltar khas blangs pa: khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab: mngon spyod phrin las myur du mdzod: ha na ha na badz+ra: da ha da ha badz+ra: pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra: ma thā ma thā badz+ra: dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+ra: su ru su ru badz+ra: mu ru mu ru badz+ra: ka taṃ ka ye dza ye bi dza ye: a tsi te a pa ra tsi te: mā ra se na: pra mar+dha na ye hūm̐ phaṭa: sha chen gyi dud pa gtang: dar nag g.yab: bshugs pa'i sgra dang rkang gling 'bud do: rdo rje gzhon nu'i mtshan ma rdzas kyi dbang bskur rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:
